special_traits.name: Amphibious
special_traits.description: The dragon can breathe air and water.

special_traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
special_traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Acid Arrow (level 4 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +15, reach 15 ft. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: Acid Breath (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 22, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 10-footwide Line. Failure: 67 (15d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

legendary_actions.name: Cloud of Insects
legendary_actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. Failure: 33 (6d10) Poison damage, and the target has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Frightful Presence
legendary_actions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Fear. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Pounce
legendary_actions.description: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
